why: A flying book whose ink pages change is already a page you would want to turn, so the idea holds and the pet needs no change.

veto.why: At icon size the ink lines turn to noise, and the system's glass sheen over every icon is exactly the gloss this guards against.

style: Hand-inked outlines on visible paper, flat color, and no gloss or 3D shading.
making: Worry: nineteen separate sessions may drift glossy; the style sheet must show ink lines and paper, and the review should reject gloss.
